blind.B1: No exercise arm: C2C12 myoblasts with miR-486 mimic vs scramble (S2.8.p1). It is an in-vitro follow-up on an exercise-related EV miRNA (miR-486, elevated in CP); not an exercise series. Policy question on in-vitro mediator series.
blind.B2: miR-486 mimic (n=3) vs scramble control (n=3); 'independently repeated at least in triplicate' (S2.8.p1).
blind.B3: No repeated measures; independent transfections. Title-suffix key is only a replicate label (expression check not supported).
blind.B4: Paper does not state a model for the C2C12 RNA-seq (S2.9.p2 describes only the miRNA-seq model). Only the miR-486 vs scramble pair exists.
blind.B5: For C2C12 RNA-seq the paper gives no explicit DEG rule in Methods; S2.9.p2 FDR BH adjusted p<0.05 applies to miRNA-seq; S2.9.p4 FDR<0.05 for GO/KEGG. Complete DEG list in Supp Table S2; no counts stated in text I read.

human_items: Policy (open): whether in-vitro exercise-mediator series such as miR-486 mimic count as exercise studies.
summary: 拒绝运行的理由属实：C2C12 miR-486 模拟物实验没有运动因素，且已标注为体外机制性后续实验。是否将此类体外介质系列计入运动研究属于开放政策问题。
